facts.fact: Madagascar's Digital Governance Unit ensures interoperability between the Justice Department, the Civil Registry and other public services for the new Unique Identifier Number (NUI) programme, as TechAfrica News reports.

systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior and Decentralization

MDG.note: The enrolment targets adults aged 18 and above; no number at birth is stated.

facts.fact: Madagascar launched national biometric enrolment on 27 January 2026 to assign a Unique Identifier Number (NUI) to over 12 million people, starting with a pilot in Atsimondrano district before a nationwide rollout planned April to June 2026 (TechAfrica News, World Bank PRODIGY).
The programme captures fingerprints, facial recognition and iris scans to ensure the uniqueness of each record and eliminate duplicate identities, TechAfrica News reports.

systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior and Decentralization
